content.tex: On the diagram, sketch the graph of \(y = f(x)\) for values of \(x\) between \(-5\) and 5.
Find the maximum value of f(\(x).\)
Write down the equation of each asymptote.
The equation \(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{x^{2}} = x^{2} -2\) can be rearranged to the form \(x^{4} +ax^{2} +bx+c = 0\) .
Find the values of a, \(b\) and \(c\) .
